prompts.question: Has the accounting or audit firm, or any of its audit partners, been sanctioned, fined, or reprimanded by the Audit Oversight Board (AOB)?
prompts.why_it_matters: AOB sanctions indicate severe audit quality deficiencies or non-compliance with international auditing standards, which undermines client credibility and can disqualify the firm from auditing public interest entities.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the public AOB Sanctions directory for the firm name or partner name
prompts.found_when: The firm or a partner is listed with an active sanction, reprimand, or fine
prompts.not_found_when: The search executes and returns zero disciplinary records or sanctions against the firm and partners
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The Securities Commission portal is down or unreachable

prompts.question: Is the firm's nominated tax partner or principal officially licensed as an approved Tax Agent under Section 153(3) of the Income Tax Act 1967?
prompts.why_it_matters: Offering commercial tax filing and advisory without a valid Section 153 MOF tax agent license is an offense under Malaysian law and leaves client submissions rejected or penalized by LHDN.
prompts.how_to_query: Query the e-Semakan Ejen Cukai section on MyCukai using the partner IC number, tax agent approval number, or practitioner name
prompts.found_when: The named practitioner or firm partner is not listed as holding an active Section 153 tax agent license
prompts.not_found_when: The practitioner is confirmed with an active MOF tax agent approval reference
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The MyCukai portal is undergoing maintenance or session timeouts

Managing partner verified as approved tax agent and company auditor

prompts.question: Does the firm possess a valid Malaysian Institute of Accountants (MIA) Firm Registration Number (AF/NF number) matching its public claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Under the Accountants Act 1967, only firms registered with MIA holding an AF or NF number can legally offer statutory audit or public accounting services in Malaysia.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify firm registration number (AF prefix for audit, NF for non-audit) on MIA public search or search index: site:mia.org.my {company}
prompts.found_when: The firm claims to be Chartered Accountants or an audit practice but has no registered AF/NF number on the MIA roll
prompts.not_found_when: Firm registration number and practicing partner credentials match MIA records
prompts.couldnt_check_when: MIA website triggers Cloudflare bot challenges or rate limits

prompts.question: Has the firm or any of its partners been subject to published disciplinary orders, fines, or striking off by the MIA Disciplinary Committee?
prompts.why_it_matters: Published MIA disciplinary orders alert potential clients to professional misconduct, breach of the MIA By-Laws, or failed practice reviews.
prompts.how_to_query: Search published MIA Disciplinary orders under Accountants Today / Enforcement decisions for {person} or {company}
prompts.found_when: A published order lists the member/firm with a formal censure, penalty, suspension, or expulsion
prompts.not_found_when: Zero disciplinary orders or complaints are recorded against the practitioner
prompts.couldnt_check_when: MIA enforcement database requires CAPTCHA verification

prompts.question: Does the firm claim to provide statutory company audits without holding an active Minister of Finance Company Auditor approval under Section 263 of the Companies Act 2016?
prompts.why_it_matters: Performing or advertising statutory company audits without MOF/SSM approval violates the Companies Act 2016 and invalidates statutory financial statements submitted to SSM.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify company auditor license number format (e.g. [No]/[Year] (J)) cited on audit reports against SSM statutory records
prompts.found_when: Firm advertises statutory audit services but neither firm nor partners hold an approved auditor license number
prompts.not_found_when: Auditor license number is verified active and valid
prompts.couldnt_check_when: SSM statutory search portal is unavailable

prompts.question: Does the firm's website claim ACCA Approved Employer or ACCA Quality Checked status when it is not listed in ACCA's official directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely advertising ACCA accreditation or employer status misleads prospective recruits and clients, creating reputational exposure and trademark infringements.
prompts.how_to_query: Search ACCA directory of approved employers and practicing firms filtered by Malaysia and {company}
